You can see here Secret Service making their way to the Cabinet— walking across chairs while guests ducked underneath tables trying to figure out exactly what was happening. I was with Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin. We are safe.

Video

Gunshots and chaos at the White House Correspondents' Dinner in Washington, DC where President Trump, Vice President Vance, the First Lady, members of the Cabinet, Congress and hundreds of journalists gathered at the Washington Hilton -- we were ushered under tables and then quickly out of the room.  President Trump is safe and will hold a news conference from the White House shortly--video I took coming next here on X

President Trump plans to speak from the White House tonight. #foxnews #whcd #breakingnews
